title: Samuel Leads Revival

questions.question: Where was the ark taken?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:1 (ESV): “And the men of Kiriath-jearim came and took up the ark of the Lord...”

questions.question: What did Samuel urge Israel to do?
options: Put away foreign gods and serve the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Put away foreign gods and serve the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:3 (ESV): “...put away the foreign gods and the Ashtaroth from among you and direct your heart to the Lord...”

questions.question: Where did Israel gather to repent?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:5 (ESV): “Then Samuel said, ‘Gather all Israel at Mizpah...’”

questions.question: What did Samuel name the stone after victory?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:12 (ESV): “...called its name Ebenezer; for he said, ‘Till now the Lord has helped us.’”

questions.question: Who attacked Israel during their gathering?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:7 (ESV): “...the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel...”

questions.question: Whose house was the ark brought to?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:1 (ESV): "...brought it to the house of Abinadab on the hill."

questions.question: Who was consecrated to keep the ark?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:1 (ESV): "...And they consecrated his son Eleazar to have charge of the ark of the LORD."

questions.question: How long did the ark remain at Kiriath-jearim?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:2 (ESV): "From the day that the ark was lodged at Kiriath-jearim, a long time passed, some twenty years..."

questions.question: What weapon did the Lord use against the Philistines at Mizpah?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:10 (ESV): "...But the LORD thundered with a mighty sound that day against the Philistines and threw them into confusion..."

questions.question: Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life. Where was his home?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:17 (ESV): "Then he would return to Ramah, for his home was there, and there also he judged Israel..."

questions.question: What specific idols did the people put away?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:4 (ESV): "So the people of Israel put away the Baals and the Ashtaroth..."

questions.question: What ritual did they perform at Mizpah besides fasting?
options: Drew water and poured it out before the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Drew water and poured it out before the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:6 (ESV): "...they drew water and poured it out before the LORD and fasted on that day..."

questions.question: What offering did Samuel offer while the Philistines drew near?
options: A sucking lamb as a whole burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: A sucking lamb as a whole burnt offering
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:9 (ESV): "So Samuel took a nursing lamb and offered it as a whole burnt offering to the LORD..."

questions.question: The cities Israel recovered were from ______ to ______.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:14 (ESV): "The cities that the Philistines had taken from Israel were restored to Israel, from Ekron to Gath..."

questions.question: Besides the Philistines, who was there peace with?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 7:14 (ESV): "...and there was peace between Israel and the Amorites."

key_verse_text: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen and called its name Ebenezer; for he said, “Till now the LORD has helped us.” (ESV)
